name: Kerehaklu Mosto Fermentation
description: Grown at Kerehaklu Estate in the lush forests of Chikmagalur, this experimental lot undergoes an anoxic mosto fermentation that amplifies its vibrant fruit character while preserving the estate’s unique terroir. Expect a juicy cup layered with passion fruit, ripe blueberry, and red currant, balanced by a rounded body and lingering cocoa finish.

name: Raxidi Lobo's P1 Natural
description: The finest coffee cherries were selectively picked, then thoroughly washed and placed in a stainless steel container. A P1 strain, a mix of yeast and bacteria, was then introduced to ferment the cherries in an anaerobic environment for 18 hours. Once fermentation was complete, the cherries were transferred to raised beds for slow drying over 21 days. Throughout the drying process, the temperature and humidity were carefully monitored to maintain a controlled environment.

name: Raxidi Lobo's W1 Natural
description: The finest coffee cherries were selectively picked, thoroughly washed, and placed in a stainless steel container. A W1 strain, a mix of yeast and bacteria, was then introduced to ferment the cherries in an anaerobic environment for 20 hours. Once fermentation was complete, the cherries were transferred to raised beds for slow drying over 21 days. Throughout the drying process, the temperature and humidity were carefully monitored to maintain a controlled environment.

name: Candolim Blend
description: The Candolim Blend combines washed single-origin coffees with peaberry to create a rich, layered profile. Nutty undertones meet the smooth sweetness of maple, while a hint of sweet spice adds intrigue. Balanced and full-bodied, this blend is well-suited for espresso or slow-brewed cups alike.

name: Barista Series of 2-WayCup
description: Introducing the Barista Series of 2-WayCup, expertly crafted for coffee shops and enthusiasts of both espresso and milk coffee. This innovative cup features an enhanced shape designed for maximum comfort, ensuring that every sip is a pleasure. With its unique 2-way drinking experience, we elevate the enjoyment of coffee to new heights. But it doesn’t stop there—this series is also ideal for milk-based drinks, allowing baristas to create stunning latte art with ease. Whether you’re savoring a rich espresso or a creamy latte, the Barista Series is designed to meet the needs of all coffee aficionados. name: Excelsa
description: Excelsa — Mooleh Manay Estate, Coorg Origin Grown amidst the serene backwaters of the Harangi Reservoir in Coorg, Mooleh Manay Estate is a fourth- generation farm now led by Komal and Akshay Dashrath. With 75 acres of clay-loamy soil and 65 inches of annual rainfall, their approach blends data-driven precision with a deep respect for nature. Every cherry is selectively hand-picked, fermented with intent, and dried with patience each step reflecting the care and curiosity that define their craft. About the Producer The estate works closely with the South India Coffee Company (SICC)  a green coffee collective committed to transparency, traceability, and research. Through SICC Labs, the company explores low- intervention species and climate-resilient coffee farming, charting a sustainable future for Indian coffee. Why Excelsa While most of the world’s attention rests on Arabica and Robusta, Excelsa remains a quiet outlier. A rare coffee species that bridges intensity and intrigue. Once grown along farm borders in India, Excelsa trees tower high and challenge harvesters with their wild nature. Yet within their small, round beans lies an extraordinary spectrum of flavor — bright, juicy, and surprisingly complex. The Mooleh Manay Excelsa lot we roast has been DNA-verified by the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, and naturally carries a low caffeine content (0.9–0.98%) without compromising on depth. Even in milk-based brews, it retains its vivid fruit character, a rarity in the world of coffee. name: Solo Dripper — Mazelab
description: Designed by Jackie Tran (WBrC 2024 Finalist), the Solo Dripper is a compact pour-over brewer built for clarity, balance, and portability. Made from durable polypropylene, it’s lightweight enough to travel yet precise enough for competition-level brews. The Solo’s 40° angled walls, curved base, and central flow channel are engineered for clean, consistent extraction. Water moves smoothly through the coffee bed for faster flow, bright flavors, and well-rounded cups without over-extraction. Every detail — from geometry to flow rate — is intentional. Even saturation, minimal channeling, and repeatable results make it a brewer you can rely on anywhere — at home, in the café, or on the road. Why it stands out Bright, clean cups — faster flow highlights clarity and vibrancy. Balanced extraction — 40° angle + curved base ensures even saturation. Built for consistency — easy to control taste through grind and pour. Durable & portable — compact, travel-ready polypropylene design. Designed for brewers — created by a World Brewers Cup finalist. name: Aarambol Blend
description: A lively fusion of naturals and washed single-origin coffees, the Aarambol Blend is both bold and expressive. Bursting with bright berry notes, it is rounded by smooth cocoa and the gentle sweetness of brown sugar. Fruity yet comforting, it’s a versatile blend for those who enjoy vibrant, characterful cups.

name: Morjim Blend
description: Crafted from the renowned Ratnagiri Estate, the Morjim Blend is a single-origin coffee with depth and character. Rich dark chocolate anchors the cup, layered with the sweetness of cherry fruit and the smooth nuttiness of almond. Perfect for espresso, French press, or cold brew, it also rewards as a pour-over with its full-bodied and balanced profile.

name: Discovery pack of 3 (75 Gram Each)
description: Anjuna Blend: A smooth espresso blend with a medium body, featuring rich chocolate notes, sweet raisins, and a hint of pear. Perfectly balanced for a rich and flavorful experience. Ratnagiri Washed: A clean and vibrant single origin with notes of dark chocolate, cherry fruit, and raisins. Perfectly crafted for a refined, flavorful cup. Microlot: A rare and exclusive coffee, showcasing unique flavors and exceptional craftsmanship. Each microlot offers a distinct profile, making every sip a special experience.

name: Rum Barrel Aged
description: For the Rum barrel-aged process, we started it with soaking oak barrels in rum for 30 days, allowing the wood to absorb its rich, tropical flavors. Once seasoned, the barrels are emptied and filled with Ratnagiri Estate's natural processed beans. Over the next 45 days, the beans absorb the rum essence, resulting in a smooth coffee with hints of rum's sweetness.

name: Whiskey Barrel Aged
description: For this unique whiskey barrel-aged process, we begin by soaking barrels in premium single malt whiskey for 30 days, allowing the wood to absorb the rich, deep flavors. Once seasoned, the barrels are emptied and filled with Single Origin, Naturally processed coffee beans from Ratnagiri Estate. Over the next 45 days, the beans absorb the whiskey essence, resulting in a rich coffee with malty notes

name: Ratnagiri Estate Washed Coffee
description: Ratnagiri Washed coffee undergoes a meticulous washed process, where the ripe Cauvery cherries are carefully picked and pulped to remove the outer fruit. The beans are then fermented to break down any remaining mucilage, followed by a thorough washing with fresh water. This process highlights the coffee's intrinsic flavors, bringing out the rich notes of dark chocolate, cherry fruit, and raisins, making it a clean and vibrant cup grown at 1350 MASL

name: Cascara
description: Cascara stands as a testament to the principles of the circular economy movement, transforming coffee fruit peels, typically discarded, into a valuable product. This innovative approach involves processing the overlooked byproduct into a brew reminiscent of fruity loose leaf tea or incorporating it into artisanal baking. The introduction of single origin cascara serves a dual purpose. Primarily, it aims to create a continuous cycle of value for our producer partners at the source. Secondly, it seeks to highlight the rich sensory diversity of microlot Cascara, an often overlooked byproduct of the coffee industry. This mirrors the existing appreciation for the varied profiles found in coffee itself, presenting a new dimension to the overall coffee experience.

name: Vasco Da Gama Blend
description: Vasco da Gama Blend – Designed to redefine your cold brew ritual, the Vasco da Gama Blend brings together bold richness and refreshing clarity. Layers of dark chocolate provide depth, while vibrant berry notes and a crisp hint of apple add brightness and balance. Smooth and velvety, this blend is crafted to shine in cold brew, delivering a refined cup that feels both indulgent and refreshing. With every sip, Vasco da Gama captures the spirit of adventure—perfect for those seeking sophistication in their everyday coffee.

name: Anjuna Blend
description: Anjuna Blend Introducing the Anjuna Blend—your perfect espresso companion. This smooth coffee offers a medium body with a lingering chocolate finish, accented by the sweetness of raisins and the fruity essence of pear. Subtle nutty undertones bring balance, making it versatile whether enjoyed as a straight espresso or in your favorite milk-based beverage.
